title: Nutritional powder mix, sugar free (Carnation Instant Breakfast)

content.title: About
content.content: The sugar‑free Nutritional powder mix Carnation Instant Breakfast is a dry breakfast beverage enriched with vitamins and minerals. It dissolves quickly in milk or water, providing a balanced blend of protein, carbohydrates and healthy fats without added sugar.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Designed for quick preparation and convenient for travel or work.
Provides 20% of the daily value of vitamin D and 30% of vitamin B12.
Contains no added sugar yet retains a pleasant creamy taste thanks to natural sweeteners.
Suitable for vegetarians but not vegans because of dairy ingredients.
Package yields 30 servings; each serving is 30 g.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B6, B12 and niacin support energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Contains calcium and vitamin D
items.content: Help maintain healthy bones and teeth.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Each serving delivers about 8 g of protein, aiding muscle repair.

items.title: Low in sugar
items.content: Suitable for individuals monitoring blood glucose levels.

items.title: Provides iron
items.content: Supports normal blood formation and oxygen transport.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: The product contains milk powder and may cause discomfort for those with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: People allergic to casein should avoid consumption.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Those limiting salt intake should monitor total daily sodium.

items.title: Not a complete meal replacement
items.content: The powder is intended as a supplement, not as the sole source of nutrition.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one serving (30 g) of powder with 200‑250 ml of milk, water or a plant‑based beverage, stirring until fully dissolved. Add fruit, nuts or honey for extra flavor if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place with the package tightly sealed. After opening, use within 3‑4 weeks for best quality.
